slides.headline: METRO BUILDS A FIGHTING GAME
slides.deck: ONLYHANDS debuted at NYCC as a 1v1 game where artists become playable characters. Metro is its Season 1 cover artist and executive producer.

slides.headline: NAS & SLICK RICK GO MARVEL
slides.deck: At NYCC, Nas and Slick Rick joined Sanford Greene for Legend Has It Vol. 2, expanding Mass Appeal’s hip-hop-comics universe.

slides.headline: 50 CENT’S BOOK DEAL GETS TESTED
slides.deck: A Manhattan judge questioned whether 50 Cent’s $1M deal could silence Shaniqua Tompkins for life. The case returns Dec. 15.

slides.headline: JAY-Z’S BUZBEE FIGHT TAKES A TURN
slides.deck: California’s appeals court denied rehearing in Jay-Z’s Buzbee suit but left a path for lower-court review after a recantation.
